overview_description.description:
Backed by Y Combinator, Zoom and Atlassian, Spinach AI is the system of record for conversation data, transforming unstructured dialogue into a structured data asset leveraged across the enterprise by people, agents and LLMs.
We enable the Record-by-Default Enterprise!

about_short_description.short_description: The System of Record for Conversation Data

product.name: Meeting Summaries
product.description: Generates concise summaries of agile team meetings capturing decisions, action items, and blockers to support project management.

product.name: Action Items and Ticket Suggestions
product.description: Tracks meeting action items and converts them into tickets integrated with project management tools like Jira.

product.name: Integrations with Existing Tools
product.description: Connects Spinach AI to calendars, video conferencing, communication, and project management platforms for seamless workflow integration.

product.name: Knowledge Base Integration
product.description: Stores meeting notes and summaries in knowledge management platforms like Notion, Confluence, or Google Docs.

product.name: Customization and Review Controls
product.description: Allows users to review, edit, and control the distribution of meeting notes and summaries before sharing.
